concerns.text: Task T037 (multi-yield detection) is listed as a prerequisite for T017 (output writing), but T037 is marked [P] (parallel-safe). T037 consumes the stress-strain curve generated in T015b. If T037 runs in parallel with T015b, it will fail to read the artifact it depends on. The [P] tag is incorrect; T037 must be sequential after T015b.

Task T017 (Write output artifacts) lists dependencies on T037, T039, and T016. However, T017 also implicitly depends on T015a (stress-strain extraction) and T015b (drop detection) to have completed, as T037 and T016 consume their outputs. The dependency list for T017 is incomplete, risking a race condition where T017 executes before the core detection logic (T015b) finishes.

Task T028a-bis (Hold-out split) is listed as a dependency for T030 (Confusion matrix), which is correct. However, T028a-bis depends on T017 (US1 output). The task list places T028a-bis in Phase 5 (US3), but it logically requires the output of US1 (T017) to exist. While the dependency is noted, the placement in a later phase suggests a potential ordering gap if US2 (Phase 4) is not yet complete, as T028a (threshold derivation) depends on T025 (US2 output). The split should arguably happen after US2 is complete to ensure the validation set is representative of the full processed data, or the dependency chain T017 -> T028a-bis -> T028a is explicitly enforced across phases.

Tasks T032b and T033b (limit checks) depend on T035 (execution). T035 depends on T032a/T033a (instrumentation). The ordering is correct, but T032b/T033b are marked [P] (parallel-safe). While they can run in parallel with each other, they both depend on the *completion* of T035. The [P] tag might mislead an executor into thinking they can start before T035 finishes. Clarify that [P] applies only to the relationship between T032b and T033b, not their relationship to T035.
